title: Prevalence of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) in Patients With Upper Gastrointestinal Tract Symptoms in Egypt
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to calculate the prevalence of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) by mean of GERD-Q questionnaire in patients with upper gastrointestinal tract symptoms in Egypt.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years and above
* Attending the medical office and reporting symptoms suggestive of upper gastrointestinal tract symptoms such as heartburn/regurgitation, abdominal pain, bloating, belching and nausea/vomiting.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participating on a clinical trial during the last 3 months.
* Patients not able to read and/or understand the GERD-Q questionnaire.
